name: L1NormalizeQ14
adaptation: Normalize one row of eight signed INT16 samples by its L1 norm. Let D=sum(abs(X[i])), including abs(-32768)=32768. If D=0 emit eight zero lanes. Otherwise output each 16384*X[i]/D rounded to nearest integer with ties away from zero. Outputs are signed INT16 Q2.14: real +1 is raw 16384, not 32767. Retain all intermediate bits; no saturation or wrapping is necessary. The source row-wise L1 normalization and zero-row behavior are retained; exact rational arithmetic and one final Q2.14 rounding replace float arithmetic.
